name: 96792 · Waianae, HI
findings: ZIP 96792 (Waianae) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96792 (Waianae) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 96792 (Waianae) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
